g.text: T2 → S6 (airborne, guided) · T4 → S7 (armed on ground, or land): restart recovery
C2: mode manual (from any of S3–S7)
Supervise applies contingencies C1–C7 per leaf (SPEC table): first applicable row wins; S6 accepts only landing rows, S7 only C2.
T8 (internal): next leg, at most one per cycle. Each Cycle: planner outputs, events in arrival order, Supervise, Advance, one MissionOut.
Setpoints only in S4, S5, S6. Solid: commands and progress rules. Dashed: telemetry-driven and contingency transitions.
